title: Artificial Intelligence for Drainage Analysis (AIDA)
summary:
In Germany, almost 500,000 operations are performed each year with 
complication rates of up to 37% for complex visceral surgery.  Early detection of such complications is of crucial importance in order to initiate suitable countermeasures fast. An established method for the early detection of complications after pancreatic surgery is the assessment of drainage fluids. Our approach is to use bedside spectral analysis, to measure the composition of the drainage fluid. The data obtained will then be compared with conventionally measured laboratory values from the blood serum and drainage fluid. We also collect data on the operation performed, complications that occur later and the medical staff's assessment of the drainage fluid. In the evaluation, we analyze correlations between all these data.
No additional measures are carried out on the patients for the study, only additional spectral images of the drainage bags are taken.
conditions: Analysis of drainage fluids from pancreatic surgery

interventions.name: Spectral and laboratory measurements of drainage fluids. The laboratory measurements correspond to the usual clinical routine. Spectral measurements are carried out on 2-4 days together with the routine laboratory and additionally on postoperative day 2.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Ability to understand the nature and individual consequences of the study
- Written informed consent
- Planned elective pancreatic resection
- Planned abdominal drainage
Exclusion criteria:
- Legal representation
- Inability to communicate (cognitive or due to language barrier)
- Inability to understand the nature of this study
